All tests pass. Here's what was implemented in `ringbuf.c`:

- **`rb_create`** — allocates the struct + zeroed internal buffer of the given capacity; returns NULL for capacity==0 or OOM
- **`rb_destroy`** — frees buf and struct; accepts NULL safely
- **`rb_write`** — writes bytes from `data`, wrapping `head` modulo capacity; stops at capacity (full) and returns how many were written
- **`rb_read`** — reads oldest-first, advancing `tail`; returns count read, up to what's available
- **`rb_peek`** — copies from the ring without advancing `tail`
- **`rb_size` / `rb_capacity`** — return current stored bytes and total capacity
- **`rb_clear`** — resets head, tail, size to zero
